description: Nemotron-3-Nano-4B batch-1 decode after a 128-token prompt. TensorRT with Inductor regions: the session recipe, the whole-step CUDA-graph control, the kernels.inductor variants on top of the session recipe, and the strongest Inductor configurations

notes.trt-session: The recipe the published agent session selected. --session DIR replaces it with the recipe the session in DIR selected
notes.trt-session-whole-graph: Control: the session engine captured as one whole-step CUDA graph by the workload (bench.whole_graph), the capture the hybrid variants use, instead of the runtime's per-engine graphs
notes.trt-hybrid-*: The session recipe with kernels.inductor set to the value the name gives
